sources.quote: Since starting as MVP Venture Capital in 1999 ... it invests in technology, healthcare, biotechnology, information, communications, environment life, and entertainment sectors.

sources.title: Smilegate Investment Portfolio Investments
sources.supports: 212 investments, bio/healthcare portfolio incl. Alteogen, OliX, Vuno, PharmAbcine, D&D Pharmatech
sources.quote: Smilegate Investment ... portfolio companies including Donggu Bio Pharmaceutical, D&D Pharmatech, Vuno, Sujentech, Alteogen ... PharmAbcine ... and Olix Pharmaceuticals.

verification_notes: Owned by the Smilegate (gaming) group but operates as a general-purpose financial VC managing external LP blind-pool funds rather than strategic corporate CVC; classified as vc. AUM not cleanly disclosed.

strategy.thesis: KOSDAQ-listed VC spun off from PE firm Stonebridge Capital; bio/healthcare is one of its core investment verticals alongside AI, semiconductor and fintech, and it has stated an aim to widen its bio portfolio.

summary.en: Founded in 2017 as a spin-off of PE firm Stonebridge Capital, KOSDAQ-listed Stonebridge Ventures manages over $700M; bio/healthcare is a core vertical it has actively sought to expand.
summary.local: 2017년 스톤브릿지캐피탈에서 분사해 코스닥에 상장된 스톤브릿지벤처스는 7억 달러 이상을 운용하며, 바이오·헬스케어를 핵심 투자 분야로 확대해 왔다.

sources.title: Stonebridge Ventures aims to widen bio portfolio
sources.supports: Spun off from Stonebridge Capital, invests in bio industry, aims to widen bio portfolio
sources.quote: Stonebridge Ventures, spun-off from Korean private equity firm Stonebridge Capital, invests in the bio industry.

sources.title: Stonebridge Ventures (Seoul) investment portfolio
sources.supports: Founded 2017, AUM over $700M, bio/healthcare vertical
sources.quote: Stonebridge Ventures, founded in 2017 as a spin-off from Stonebridge Capital's venture capital investing arm, has an asset under management (AUM) exceeding $700 million distributed across multiple funds.

verification_notes: Founding year cited as 2017 (spin-off) though some sources say 2008; bio is one of several verticals, not an exclusive focus.
